summary:
Decision announced by Camila Reyes: November 2nd go-live. 1 open blocker, 3 people took an explicit position on an option.

## Status
Decision announced by Camila Reyes: November 2nd go-live. 1 open blocker, 3 people took an explicit position on an option.

## Decision
Camila Reyes announced the go-live as November 2nd with the manual refresh. Mei Tran said "Works for me" before the announcement. No reply recorded after the announcement from Erik Lindqvist, Mei Tran, or Nneka Abara.

## Open questions
- Who will cover the Monday manual refresh during the week of November 9th (raised by Camila Reyes)?

## Where people stand
- November 2nd go-live: Mei Tran supports ("Works for me."); Erik Lindqvist supports if someone else covers the Monday refresh the week of November 9th ("Not me.").
- November 16th go-live: Nneka Abara supports ("I'd still rather wait for the 16th"), then said "If it's merged and tested, I'm okay with the second." No explicit position on November 2nd recorded after that condition.
- Jonas Voss: no explicit position recorded on either date.

## What is blocking progress
- No one has agreed to cover the Monday manual refresh the week of November 9th; Mei Tran said she will be out and Erik Lindqvist declined (raised by Camila Reyes).

## Next steps
- Camila Reyes asked Nneka Abara to get Jonas Voss the access list; Nneka Abara said "I can get you the access list by Friday the 23rd."
- Mei Tran will have her team run the Monday refresh for the first month.
- Erik Lindqvist will confirm the duplicate-claims bug fix is merged by Wednesday.
- Camila Reyes said "we'll figure out that week" regarding coverage the week of November 9th.

## Awaiting a reply
- Camila Reyes asked for someone to cover the Monday refresh the week of November 9th; Erik Lindqvist said "Not me"; no one else volunteered.

## Things people asserted that others may want to check
- Nneka Abara said the manual refresh has a known bug that produces duplicate claims and risks regional leads seeing bad numbers.
- Erik Lindqvist said that bug is fixed in the branch and will confirm it is merged by Wednesday.
- Jonas Voss said compliance access-list review takes five business days once he receives the list.
- Mei Tran said regional leads have been requesting the dashboard since September.

## Flags
- Camila Reyes described the group as converging on November 2nd; the record shows Erik Lindqvist's support is conditional on someone covering the week of November 9th, Nneka Abara's acceptance is conditional on the bug fix being confirmed merged and tested, and Jonas Voss has no explicit position recorded.
